name: Accessible Garden Home
tagline: Two compact modules side by side, designed around a step-free route, generous circulation and an adaptable bathroom and kitchen.
description: Two 20-foot modules sit side by side to make a compact single-storey home. The entrance, garden doors and internal route are step-free, with a ground-floor bedroom, an adaptable bathroom and a kitchen designed for seated use. A roof canopy covers the garden terrace. Accessibility is a design target across the whole home, not a badge on one room.

architecture.intent: Compact single-storey home organised around step-free circulation and adaptability.

roof_form.maintenance: Canopy and gutter access need a safe plan.
roof_form.note: Roof geometry is conceptual and independent of the container geometry. It does not create an occupied storey.

envelope.thermal_breaks: continuous external insulation with thermal washers and stainless fasteners; breaks at openings, pile caps and service penetrations
